operations.claim: retrieves the channel object at index i from the channels list
copies sample data into the allocated packet buffer
creates a shared packet referencing sample data of the given length
allocates a packet buffer of the given sample data length
retrieves the subsamples buffer for the given track and sample number
constructs a property referencing the SAI buffer of the given size
constructs a property referencing the moof template buffer of the given size
constructs a string property from the URL string
retrieves the tfrf box for the given track

states.claim: read->pid is non-NULL and refers to the input filter PID used for packet retrieval, EOS checks, property queries, and event sending.
read->channels is a list whose entries are ISOMChannel objects obtained via gf_list_get; each ch refers to a channel object with fields playing, eos_sent, pid, sample, etc.
ch->pid refers to the output filter PID for the channel, used for EOS signaling and property setting.

ch->sample is a sample object obtained by isor_reader_get_sample or isor_reader_get_sample_from_item; when non-NULL it provides data and dataLength for packet creation, and is released via isor_reader_release_sample.

pck is a GF_FilterPacket allocated via gf_filter_pck_new_shared or gf_filter_pck_new_alloc; if allocation fails the function returns GF_OUT_OF_MEM; otherwise pck is populated and sent via gf_filter_pck_send.
read->mov is a GF_ISOFile used for sample queries, subsample buffer retrieval, fragment start checks, and tfrf retrieval.
subs_buf is a pointer to a subsample buffer returned by gf_isom_sample_get_subsamples_buffer; when non-NULL it is passed as data to PROP_DATA_NO_COPY for the packet property.
ch->sai_buffer is a buffer of size ch->sai_buffer_size used as data for the GF_PROP_PCK_CENC_SAI packet property when ch->pck_encrypted is set.
finfo.moof_template is a pointer to a moof template of size finfo.moof_template_size, passed as data to PROP_DATA for the GF_PROP_PCK_MOOF_TEMPLATE packet property.

executions.claim: If read->in_error is nonzero, the function returns immediately and no further processing occurs.
When read->pid is set and no packet is available, if read->wait_for_source is true, execution returns GF_EOS if the pid is at EOS, otherwise returns GF_OK; otherwise the fetch loop breaks.
When read->mem_load_mode is nonzero, each fetched packet is pushed as a buffer; when read->moov_not_loaded equals 2, the packet is dropped and the function returns GF_OK.
After dropping a packet, if read->in_error becomes nonzero, the function returns that error.
If read->invalid_segment is set and in_is_eos is false, the function returns GF_OK; otherwise it clears invalid_segment, sends EOS on all playing channels, sets eos_signaled, and returns GF_EOS.
If read->moov_not_loaded equals 1, the function returns GF_OK when mem_load_mode is set, otherwise clears moov_not_loaded and returns the result of isoffin_setup.
For each channel, if ch->playing is false the loop continues; otherwise if ch->eos_sent is false, is_active is set true.
Inside the sample loop, if full_segment_flush is false and the channel pid would block, the loop breaks.
If read->stsd is set and the channel's last_sample_desc_index differs from it and a sample exists, the sample is released and the loop continues.

If ch->sample is non-null, a packet is produced and sent; otherwise if ch->last_state is GF_EOS, EOS handling occurs and the loop breaks; otherwise if ch->last_state is GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE, the function returns that state; otherwise force_fetch is set and the loop breaks.
When ch->last_state is GF_EOS and ch->playing equals 2, if in_is_eos is true ch->playing is set false, otherwise nb_forced_end is incremented and check_forced_end is set true.
If mem_load_mode is set and min_offset_plus_one is nonzero, memory is purged up to min_offset_plus_one minus one.
executions.evidence:
L345: if (read->mem_load_mode && min_offset_plus_one) {
L346: isoffin_purge_mem(read, min_offset_plus_one-1);

executions.claim: If read->pid is set, check_forced_end is true, and nb_forced_end equals count, a stop event is sent to the input pid.
If is_active is false, the function returns GF_EOS; otherwise it returns GF_OK.
